t: Shelosha sheakelu keechad venipredu leinyan hazzimmun, umah dinan
s: Shelosha sheakelu keechad venipredu leinyan hazzimmun, umah dinan, ubo g' seipim: shelosha sheakelu keachat veshakechu uberak kol echad leatzmo — batel mehem hazzimmun, veen yekolim lachazor ulezammen, sheen zimmun lemaprea. Veken im bereku shenayim mehem — en hashshelishi yakol lezammen immahem. Abal im echad mehem shakach uberak leatzmo — yekolim hashshenayim haacherim lezammen immo, veyakol laanot "baruk sheakalnu" ap al pi shello akal kelum achar shebberak birkat hammazon, mippene shekkebar nitztarep immahem baakilato qodem shebberak birkat hammazon. Veap al pi shekkebar berak achar akilato — en bekak kelum lehaomerim sheim shenayim akelu pat hashshelishi mitztarep immahem lezimmun apillu lo akal immahem pat ella yaraq velo nitchayyeb bebirkat hammazon kelal, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman qtz"z. Veap al pi shehaokel yaraq umebarek acharayv beraka acharona shub eno mitztarep lezimmun, mippene shekkebar nistalleq mehem, mikkol maqom, kan sheakal pat veniqba immahem — lo nistalleq mehem bebirkato leatzmo leinyan shello yukelu haacherim lezammen immo. Vaapillu lehaomerim sheen mitztarep lishlosha ella im ken akal kezayit pat, veyesh lachosh ledibrehem lekattechilla, kemo sheyyitbaer sham, mikkol maqom, kan hare kebar akal pat immahem venitztarep immahem lezimmun, ella shemmippene shekkebar berak leatzmo batel hazzimmun mimmennu mippene sheen zimmun lemaprea, velaken lo batel ella mimmennu, abal lo mehaacherim shello bereku adayin, lepikak, hem yotzeim yede zimmun, abal hu eno yotze. Veim haechad lo berak leatzmo ella zimmen im shenayim acherim — eno mitztarep im hashshenayim sheakelu immo, veen yekolim lezammen immo:

Shelosha sheakelu veyatza echad mehem lashshuq — qoreim oto umodiim lo sherotzim lezammen, kede sheyyekavven veyitztarep immahem veyaaneh immahem birkat zimmun, veyotzeim yede chobatam, vegam hu yotze yede chobato ap al pi sheeno ba veyosheb immahem, ella sheomed lipne happetach, raq sheyyishma ad siyyum birkat "hazzan", kemo shennitbaer besiman qtz"g. Bammeh debarim amurim? Bishlosha, abal baasara, kevan shetztzerikim lehazkir et hashshem — enan mitztorpin ad sheyyabo veyesheb immahem, shebbepachot measara sheyyoshebim beyachad — en derek eretz lehazkir et hashshem:

Shelosha sheakelu keachat veen echad mehem yodea kol birkat hammazon, ella echad yodea beraka rishona veechad hashsheniyya veechad hashshelishit — mechuyyabim bezimmun, vekol echad yebarek habberaka sheyyodea, vehashshenayim shomeim veyotzeim yede chobatam, vehayyodea beraka rishona hu mezammen veomer: "nebarek sheakalnu mishshello, baruk sheakalnu mishshello ubetubo chayinu", im hu yodea vehem enam yodeim laanot. Veim hu eno yodea, ap al pi sheechad mehem yodea — en mezammenim kelal, shei epshar lahem lechalleq birkat hazzimmun ubirkat "hazzan" lishnayim, lepi shehaiqqar kehaomerim she"nebarek" enah beraka bipne atzmah kelal, kemo shennitbaer besiman qtz"g, ella mebarekim belo zimmun. Vehu haddin im hem shenayim veechad mehem yodea shette berakot veechad hashshelishit. Abal im kol hamsubbim enam yodeim ezo beraka mishshalosh berakot shel tora — lo yebareku kelal mah sheyyodeim, ki sheloshtan meakkebot zo et zo. Abal beraka rebiit shehi middibre soperim, ap al pi shekkullam en yodeim otah — enah meakkebet shalosh berakot shel tora. Ubeshalosh berakot hallalu, im echad yodea chatzi habberaka veechad chatzi hashsheniyya — en beraka achat mitchalleqet lishnayim, vehi meakkebet et shear habberakot. Veyesh omerim sheshshalosh berakot shel birkat hammazon en meakkebot zo et zo. Veyesh lachosh ledibrehem, lehachamir beshel tora:
